title: chase config
description: /etc/chase/config.json: what the NixOS module tells the chase binary, a section per part of chase that needs one. Read strictly: an unknown key, a second value or a word an enum does not have is refused.

selector.description: What sorts a checkout into a tier, and launches a session of each: chase.order, chase.fallback and chase.tiers.

order.description: chase.order: the tiers asked, first to last; the first with a rule that holds is the checkout's.

fallback.description: chase.fallback: the tier a checkout no rule holds for goes to. One of tiers, never a bare one.

wrappers.description: The agents a person runs on the host, by the name they run them as: what runs for a bare tier.

hostCommand.description: The agent's argv on the host, before the person's own arguments.

claude.description: Claude Code's login refresher and its workspace trust, when the module enables it.

claudeJson.description: The host's ~/.claude.json, where a bare tier that trusts its checkouts trusts them.

codex.description: Codex's login refresher and its placeholder login, when the module enables it.

stateDir.description: ~/.local/state/chase/codex: the placeholder and each isolated tier's CODEX_HOME.

formerStateDir.description: Where an earlier chase kept stateDir, moved from. Empty is nowhere.

sqlite.description: The sqlite3 a moved home's thread index is repointed with. Empty is none.

tokenEndpoint.description: Where the refresh token is exchanged. Empty is OpenAI's; set only by tests.

session.description: What a sandbox tier's sessions are given on the host before they start.

home.description: chase.home, the user's home on both sides of the boundary.

placeholder.description: chase.placeholder, what a session holds in place of every credential.

workspaceGroups.description: chase.workspaceGroups: checkouts worked on together, each member bound beside the others.

tiers.description: What each sandbox tier binds and runs, by tier name.

grant.description: How a checkout's own grant is approved and applied, for the tiers that take one.

uid.description: chase.uid, the user every step runs as.

state.description: Where chase keeps what it approved. Empty is home/.local/state/chase.

runtime.description: The user's runtime directory. Empty is /run/user/<uid>.

policies.description: The directory of the tiers' own frisket policy documents.

checkouts.description: Every tier's pinned checkouts: each owner/repo, and every path any tier pins it at.

apps.description: chase.internal.projectApps: what an app becomes when a project binds it, by name.

ungranted.description: The tiers that take no checkout's grant but are launched as those that do, for routes that are the tier's own.

approver.description: chase.approver: the program that asks a person to approve a grant. Empty is none.

recordDir.description: Where frisket appends a recording session's lines. Empty is the journal alone.

sops.description: The sops that decrypts a project's secrets.

diff.description: The diff that shows a person what changed.

docker.description: Docker's routes, for each tier with Docker, by tier.

grantTiers.description: The tiers that take a checkout's grant.

names.description: Each recording tier's names file: the calls its filter allows, one a line.

git.description: The git every git call runs, never looked up on PATH.

emptySha1.description: The empty sha1 repository, a store path. Both empties or neither.

emptySha256.description: The empty sha256 repository, a store path. Both empties or neither.

tokenUrl.description: Where a token's grant is posted. Empty is Google's; only a check sets it.

bare.description: chase.tiers.<name>.bare: run with no sandbox at all.

match.description: chase.tiers.<name>.match: any one of these rules, each holding when every predicate it sets does.

launcher.description: A sandbox tier's flong launcher. Empty for a bare tier.

recordLauncher.description: The tier's record launcher. Empty for a tier that does not record.

trust.description: What a bare tier trusts its checkouts in, on the host.

rule.description: One of chase.tiers.<name>.match. It sets at least one predicate.

settings.description: The tier's settings file, given as --settings.

placeholder.description: The placeholder login a session's ~/.codex is seeded with.

agent.description: The --agent `deepsec init` is given when it names none. Empty is deepsec's own default.

cloudflare.description: The Cloudflare account the tier's sessions are told.

stores.description: What the tier's sessions keep beyond themselves, by name.

scope.description: A directory per workspace, or one for the tier.

root.description: Where the tier's directories are made.

env.description: Each variable, and the path in the directory it is set to.

files.description: Each path in the directory, and the host file installed there at every launch.

trustEnv.description: The variables set to the workspace, each an app's list of trusted paths.

environment.description: What the tier's container sets in every session's environment, as flong computes it.

forward.description: Whether the tier's published ports go on the project's own address.

nix.description: The tier's apps.nix: how a checkout's devShell is realised on the host.

timeout.description: How many seconds a realisation may take.

nixpkgs.description: What <nixpkgs> is to a checkout's shell.nix.

system.description: The devShells.<system> a flake's is taken from.

pathFront.description: The entries of the container's PATH a devShell's go behind.

routes.description: By tier: a frisket route, or a list of them.

envFromGrant.description: Each variable, and the binding's field it is taken from.

credential.description: Whether the app is bound only with the project's secret. Absent is true.

frisketRoute.description: A route as frisket's policy reads it, which frisket's own schema describes.

gcloud.description: Google Cloud, for each tier that has it.

apis.description: The APIs the tier carries, by Discovery name.

every.description: Every method a rule may name.

systemctl.description: The systemctl the renewer is started with.

ssh.description: SSH, for each tier that has it.

catalogue.description: The Linux catalogue, in the store.

catalogues.description: chase.apps.ssh.catalogues, each in the store, by name.

identity.description: The one key of the agent's to offer.

env.description: apps.ssh.env: the variables a command may set for itself in front of it.

hosts.description: The tier's own machines, by the name ssh knows each by in the sandbox.

hostKeys.description: The machine's own keys, as known_hosts writes them less the host.

shell.description: Commands are typed into the login shell on a terminal.

unmatched.description: Answers a command no rule matches, in place of the tier's.

catalogue.description: The one of catalogues this machine's commands are decided by.

expect.description: What each command must be answered when the system is built.
